accuracyFlags: Section 8 says the bush campgrounds (Brachina, Bunyeroo) are 'first come and rarely full', but section 1 says to choose a booked campground and the SA National Parks listings show Ikara-Flinders campgrounds (Cambrian, Koolamon, Youngoona, Aroona, Dingly Dell) take online bookings and fees. The page contradicts itself and the first-come claim looks wrong.

Claims Adnyamathanha Traditional Owners ask visitors not to climb St Mary Peak and that Tanderra Saddle is the 'respectful alternative'. Third-party sources repeat this but SA National Parks promotes the summit walk; verify wording against parks.sa.gov.au and Adnyamathanha guidance before stating it as a request.
No park entry/camping fee or 2026 date given, no official link (parks.sa.gov.au).
